children: WinVest Acquisition secured additional time to complete a business combination by amending its trust agreement with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, extending the liquidation deadline to Oct 17, 2026 and enabling up to five one-month extensions through Mar 17, 2027 with $30,000 deposited per extension. To support these deposits and related costs, the company issued a non-interest-bearing promissory note of up to $180,000 to its Sponsor. The moves aim to preserve investor capital in trust while providing flexibility to finalize a transaction.
